entries.message: Site icons are never asked of an address on the local network, whether a page's icon link, a redirect or the name's own address leads there.
Passwords imported during setup keep the notes and code keys they bring, and one whose notes can't be saved counts as unsaved.
When imported passwords save but some of their notes or code keys can't, Settings says how many and asks to import the file again.
When moving a Space's passwords into or out of iCloud fails partway, their notes and code keys go back with them.
A login moved between Spaces from two windows at once moves only once, so neither move deletes the other's copy.
A page moved to the other engine offers saved passwords again unless the new engine has an extension handling them.
